## Title / Summary
Short title and a concise description of the task or investigation.

## Business Value / User Outcome
Why this work is needed and what problem it addresses.

## Scope
What will be investigated, built, or delivered.

## Acceptance Criteria / Deliverable
- [ ] ...
- [ ] ...

## Dependencies and Assumptions
Any prerequisites, unknowns, or constraints.

## Security / Privacy / Data Considerations
Note only if relevant.

## Architecture / Design Considerations
Relevant system context, design options, or implementation constraints.

## Testing Expectations
How the result should be validated, including any proof-of-concept or investigation method.

## Documentation Expectations
Any notes, ADR follow-up, or implementation docs needed.

## Definition of Ready Checks
- [ ] Objective is clear
- [ ] Scope is bounded
- [ ] Deliverable or success criteria is defined
- [ ] Dependencies/assumptions are captured
- [ ] Security/data is considered if relevant
- [ ] Design/architecture is noted if relevant
- [ ] Validation approach is defined
- [ ] Documentation needs are identified

For a spike, the deliverable should be knowledge, a recommendation, proof of concept, or documented decision—not production implementation unless explicitly included in scope.
